title: WidgetKit Timeline Entries
hints: Generate the moments: now, then each whole hour.
For each moment, the entry shows the first event still in the future.
Drop consecutive duplicates; the reload time is one hour after the last moment.
jsBridge: WidgetKit widgets don't run code on demand. You give the system a **timeline** of pre-rendered entries up front. It's closer to generating static pages with a revalidate schedule (ISR) than to a live React component.

compass.q: Next.js ISR regenerates pages on a schedule. How is a widget timeline with a `.after(date)` reload policy similar?
Why can't a widget show a live seconds counter by re-rendering? What does `Text(date, style: .timer)` do instead?
`.atEnd` vs `.after(date)` vs `.never` reload policies: which for a calendar widget?
Updating the widget when the app's data changes: which API (`WidgetCenter.shared.reloadAllTimelines()`)?
